description: This organisation's landing rules, ownership record and safety rules for scientific research, in one place: who asks and who the scientist is, what landed means for a protocol, a run, a result, a claim inside the group and a claim outside it, who does the work, where a maintainer's green light applies (none by default), the irreversible steps (all the scientist's), the ownership record, where the records are kept, and the house rules every role follows (instance names, the model floor for children, the hosts, secrets, untrusted text, a person's word passed on, sources, instruments, what must not leave). Composed by every soul, so every role's safety rules have one home. Two skills hold what the briefing leaves out: landing-rules-detail (CI green, VERIFIED and what carries to a new head, the green light, the model floor, the statistical sign-off, the profiles, publishing, the findings worth keeping, the study records and holds, who does which work, changes to the rules) and wait-and-retire (the checkpoint that bounds a wait on an instance, what finished means per seat, retiring yourself and the parent's sweep). The template's rules are an example to adapt. Copied from the scientific research template, template-v3.0.0.
